criteria.criterion: The plan fence allows Edit and Write of `.vloop/state/gates/**` beside `.vloop/state/state.json`; the work and review fences deny them; a gate folder whose id is not in the plan refuses the plan (exit 1, nothing committed).
criteria.evidence: fence/plan.json adds Edit/Write(.vloop/state/gates/**); internal/driver/plan.go acceptPlan adds a problem per StrayGateFolders entry, and reject removes state and gates and halts with ExitPreflight before any commit. The work and review fences are unchanged and still deny .vloop/state/**.

criteria.criterion: At acceptance the driver stamps each task's `fixtures`: lower-case hex SHA-256 over the folder's regular files sorted by path, each fed as `<path>\0<contents>\0` with the path relative to the gate folder and `/`-separated, so the value is the same on every OS; a task with no folder gets "". The digest is a pure function with a unit test that runs on every OS.
criteria.evidence: internal/state/fixtures.go FixturesDigest and digestFiles use ToSlash, sort and path NUL contents NUL; plan.go acceptPlan calls StampFixtures; TestFixturesDigest and TestStampAndStray in internal/state/fixtures_test.go.

criteria.criterion: VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 covers state.json and every gate folder; the driver holds both in memory, restores whatever any session changed among them after the session, and `vloop task gate` refuses on a mismatch with the existing message.
criteria.evidence: safety.go stateGuard keeps pre and gates in memory, hash() is PlanDigest, and restoreIfTouched calls RestoreGateFiles; iterate.go uses guard.hash() for the work and review sessions; cli/task_gate.go checkPlanHash uses PlanDigest over GateFiles. TestStateGuardGateFolders, TestPlanDigestAndRestore and TestTaskGatePlanHash cover it.

criteria.criterion: `vloop run` resuming a plan whose gate folder no longer matches a task's fixtures refuses with `vloop: the gate fixtures of T<n> changed outside vloop task verify — record the change with vloop task verify T<n> --reason '<why>'` (exit 1), starting no session.
criteria.evidence: driver.CheckFixtures, called in Planner.Plan's resume branch and Iterator.Run, halts with ExitPreflight and the required text. The only test that exercises it, though, is the ephemeral gate script.

criteria.criterion: `vloop task verify <id> [<command>] --reason '<why>'` takes the command optionally; it appends a gate_history entry {verify (old), fixtures (old), replaced_at, reason, by: operator}, then sets the command if given and re-stamps fixtures from the folder; with neither a new command nor a changed folder it refuses with `vloop: nothing to record — T<n>'s gate and fixtures are unchanged` (exit 1).
criteria.evidence: state.RecordGate in internal/state/fixtures.go; cli/task_gate.go newTaskVerify accepts RangeArgs(1,2); TestRecordGate, TestTaskVerifyFolder and TestTaskVerifyRefusals assert the history entry and the refusal text.

criteria.criterion: TestRun33GateRewrite's replacement tests the folder restore; TestTaskVerifyReplaces, TestTaskVerifyRefusals and TestTaskGatePlanHash follow G2; tests cover the stamp, the stray-folder refusal and the resume refusal.
criteria.evidence: The stamp and the folder restore are tested (TestStampAndStray, TestStateGuardGateFolders). The stray-folder refusal is tested only at StrayGateFolders level, so the acceptance refusal (exit 1, nothing committed) has no durable test. The resume refusal has only a FixturesMismatch unit test, so CheckFixtures, its message and its exit code are untested. driver/plan_test.go, cmd/vloop/run_gates_test.go and cmd/vloop/run_safety_test.go, all listed in files, were not touched, and the e2e script that covers these dies with the run.

findings.summary: No durable test covers acceptance refusing a stray gate folder (exit 1, nothing committed) or CheckFixtures' resume refusal with its exact message and exit 1; only the ephemeral gate script exercises them

notes: The behaviour itself looks right and the gate folders are restored for the work and review sessions. No gate-review phase exists in the driver yet, so no guard was possible for it here. A fix needs only a driver or cmd/vloop test for the two refusals.
